description: Trimmed SelfReflect VMC capture (decoded OSC). packets[i].t is seconds since the first captured packet of the full capture; msgs is the list of [address, typeTag, args] in bundle order. Indexes 0..29 of the capture: T-pose frame first, then jawOpen rises from 0 to about 0.19. Indexes 208..237: frames 212 onward repeat frame 211 byte for byte (repeated-frame run).
